text:
cameron: Heads up — planning a maintenance to swap a subset of older A100 nodes to newer A100s and to bounce NIC drivers in az3. Will be rolling and low blast radius.

sara: ETA/time windows?

cameron: Targeting Wed 2026-06-10 02:00–05:00 UTC. Rolling across 8 racks, ~1 node at a time per rack. Drain ~3m/node + validation. No full-pool outage expected.

ben: Is this going to affect Dedicated pools or only shared-hosted?

cameron: Primary impact: Dedicated capacity in pool r-dedicated-az3 for the small-burst lane. We'll throttle allocations to that pool and route ephemeral requests to other regions during the window.

diane: Any chance we can pre-warm spare GPUs to avoid cold starts for latency-critical customers?

cameron: Yes — plan includes a pre-warm run 30m prior. Command we plan to run: 

``
./tools/prewarm_gpus.sh --region az3 --pools r-dedicated-az3 --instances 24
``

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: MT-20260610-az3-capacity-swap (status: tentative) :calendar:

ben: Networking specifics — is this just NIC firmware bounce or also switch-level config push?

cameron: NIC firmware + NIC driver restart on nodes, plus a brief switch QoS policy apply (~3s) for affected leafs. We'll sequence restarts and wait for KV cache + gRPC reconnections.

sara: How long will nodes be out of rotation individually?

cameron: Expect 4–6 minutes each (drain, reboot/driver restart, healthcheck). We'll keep a 2m stagger between racks to avoid correlated load.

ops-lead: Customer comms — we should notify Dedicated customers with capacity in that pool. I'll draft an email once racks are confirmed.

diane: Cost note — spinning pre-warm instances for 30m will bump cost for that window, ~\$120/hr. Ops-lead ok with that?

ops-lead: fine, prefer cost > latency hit for paid SLAs.

ben: Rollback plan if something regresses?

cameron: If healthcheck fails, stop roll, mark node suspect, revert NIC driver to previous version, and schedule node replacement if required. We'll keep last-known-good image and config handy.

sara: Any changes to routing policy so hosted API binds to other regions automatically?

cameron: We'll add temporary routing rule to route r-hosted-az3 -> r-hosted-az1/az2 for affected pools during the window. Ops will monitor latency shift.

infra-bot: Reminder: attach final checklist to MT-20260610-az3-capacity-swap by EOD Tue 2026-06-09.

ben: I'll own validation scripts + smoke tests. diane, can you own the pre-warm work?

diane: Yep, will run dry-run in staging tomorrow.

cameron: Action items: ben: validation + smoke; diane: pre-warm + cost estimate; ops-lead: customer comms draft; sara: confirm routing change with traffic-eng. I'll post final rack list by EOD.

ops-lead: :thumbsup:
